svg.title: End-to-end pipeline: FPCA compression and cumulative year-wise prediction
svg.desc: A flowchart showing NACC patient data flowing through FPCA compression to extract w1 and w2, then through cumulative year-wise Random Forest models from Year 0 to Year 5, with R-squared values improving each year.
